description: Detects and redacts personal data in text before it is logged, stored or sent to a model: emails, phones, US SSNs, payment cards (Luhn-checked), IBANs (checksum-checked), IPv4/IPv6, URLs, dates of birth, street addresses, passport or ID numbers in context, and crypto wallet addresses. Returns the redacted text plus each finding with type, value and offsets. Modes: label ([EMAIL]), mask (****1234) or remove. Up to 200,000 characters per call; nothing leaves the server. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

include_findings.description: false to omit the findings array (default true)

text.description: Text to redact, up to 200000 characters
